# Why is the queue slow? {#queue}

The consumer acknowledges each message one by one, which costs [2 ms](typical:one local sample) per message.

## What should we change? {#change}

Batch the acknowledgements.

| Option | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| Batch acks | Fewer round trips {good:Faster} |
| Prefetch | More memory {caution} |

# What does the platform contain? {#platform}

Eight services form one chain from the edge to storage.

@meta locale=en

## How are the services connected? {#services}

@architecture id=chain title="Service chain"
| edge | Edge proxy | frontend |
| auth | Auth | security |
| api | API gateway | backend |
| orders | Orders | backend |
| billing | Billing | backend |
| queue | Event bus | messagebus |
| worker | Worker | backend |
| store | Storage | database |
| edge > auth | |
| auth > api | |
| api > orders | |
| orders > billing | |
| billing > queue | |
| queue > worker | |
| worker > store | |

## What else? {#else}

Nothing else.
